title: driver_rtlsdr: a full RTL-SDR (RTL2832U) stack for Flutter/Android
description:
End-to-end RTL-SDR (RTL2832U) stack for Flutter/Android in a single package: native USB/FFI driver (tuning, IQ streaming, WFM/NFM/AM/SSB demodulation with stereo and RDS, spectrum, recording, gain), a testable ChangeNotifier radio engine (controllers, presets), and a gqrx-inspired widget library (spectrum scope, waterfall, tuner, panels, screens). As of v0.3.0, merges the previously separate core_rtlsdr and widget_rtlsdr packages into this one. Native core in C, GPLv2.

Bundles rtlsdr_mobile, a complete reference app (USB permission flow, tuning, WFM stereo/RDS, band scan, presets, recording with a foreground service, spectrum scope + waterfall, its own adaptive launcher icon and native splash screen) alongside the package's minimal example/.
